description: Turns the video's fades on or off: videoIn (fade in from black at the start), videoOut (fade out to black at the end), musicIn and musicOut (the music's fade in and out). Off leaves the video's length unchanged: the last frame or end card holds instead of going to black, and the music stops with the picture. Only the fades passed are changed. 'No fade at the end' means videoOut false (and musicOut false if the sound is meant too).

musicIn.description: Fade the music in at the start.

musicOut.description: Fade the music out at the end.

videoIn.description: Fade in from black at the start.

videoOut.description: Fade out to black at the end.

name: set_fades
title: Fades
